name: Maldives Island Escape
description: Overwater villas, crystal-clear lagoons and world-class snorkeling in the heart of the Indian Ocean.

name: Bali Tropical Getaway
description: Ancient temples, emerald rice terraces and golden beaches on the Island of the Gods.

name: Santorini Sunset Cruise
description: Whitewashed cliffside villages, volcanic beaches and the most famous sunset in the Aegean.

name: Bora Bora Lagoon Retreat
description: Pristine lagoons surrounded by Mount Otemanu, perfect for honeymooners and luxury travelers.

name: Phuket Beach Holiday
description: Tropical paradise with island-hopping tours to Phi Phi, vibrant nightlife and Thai cuisine.

name: Miami Beach City Break
description: Sun-soaked beaches, art deco architecture and legendary Ocean Drive nightlife.

name: Waikiki Surf & Sun
description: Learn to surf where the sport was born, hike Diamond Head and catch Hawaiian sunsets.

name: Boracay White Beach Escape
description: Powder-soft white sand, turquoise waters and unforgettable island nightlife.

name: Cancun Riviera Maya
description: All-inclusive luxury on the Caribbean coast with day trips to Mayan cenotes and ruins.

name: Tulum Beach & Ruins
description: Bohemian beach town where Mayan ruins overlook the turquoise Caribbean Sea.

name: Machu Picchu Trek
description: Hike the legendary Inca Trail to the breathtaking 15th-century citadel in the clouds.

name: Great Wall Discovery
description: Walk the ancient Ming-era sections of the Great Wall and explore imperial Beijing.

name: Taj Mahal Heritage Tour
description: Witness the eternal monument of love along with the forts and palaces of Agra and Delhi.

name: Rome & Colosseum Tour
description: Gladiator history, Vatican treasures and authentic Roman cuisine la dolce vita style.

name: Petra Rose City Adventure
description: Walk through the Siq to the Treasury carved in rose-red sandstone, then camp in Wadi Rum.

name: Venice Gondola Experience
description: Canal-laced streets, St. Mark's Basilica and romantic gondola rides through history.

name: Istanbul Crossroads Tour
description: Hagia Sophia, Grand Bazaar and Bosphorus cruises where Europe meets Asia.

name: Kyoto Zen & Culture
description: Golden pavilions, geisha districts and thousands of vermilion torii gates in Japan's old capital.

name: Everest Base Camp Trek
description: Trek through Sherpa villages to stand at the foot of the world's highest mountain.

name: Swiss Alps Zermatt Ski Trip
description: Ski beneath the iconic Matterhorn with glacier views and cozy alpine chalets.

name: Banff National Park Explorer
description: Turquoise glacial lakes, stargazing and wildlife safaris in the Rocky Mountains.

name: Serengeti Great Migration Safari
description: Witness millions of wildebeest on the move and the Big Five on sunrise game drives.

name: Grand Canyon Rim to Rim
description: Epic desert hikes, helicopter views and red-rock sunsets across two billion years of geology.

name: Queenstown Adrenaline Rush
description: Bungee jumping, Milford Sound cruises and Lord of the Rings landscapes in the Southern Alps.

name: Cappadocia Balloon Ride
description: Float over fairy chimneys at sunrise and sleep in cave hotels carved from volcanic rock.

name: Dubai Desert Safari Experience
description: Dune bashing, Bedouin-style desert camps and stargazing minutes from futuristic skyscrapers.

name: Paris City of Lights
description: Eiffel Tower views, Louvre masterpieces and café culture along the Seine.

name: Tokyo Neon Discovery
description: From Shibuya crossings to tranquil temple gardens — a dazzling blend of old and new.

name: New York Big Apple Week
description: Broadway shows, Central Park strolls and skyline views from the top of Manhattan.

name: Barcelona Gaudí & Tapas
description: Sagrada Familia wonders, Gothic Quarter wandering and late-night Spanish tapas.
